channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 📶 Feature Ranker by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Turns feature requests from Slack, call notes, and support tickets into one ranked demand list for a product team.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🕵️ Rival Sweep by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Watches named competitors and reports launches, pricing, and messaging changes, with a source for every item.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎫 Ticket Desk by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Sorts a small team support queue and drafts replies for a human to review and send. Never sends, refunds, or edits tickets on its own.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎬 Rep Film by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Turns a sales call recording or transcript into timestamped coaching notes a rep can act on next call.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: ⚖️ Funnel Judge by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Clicks through a landing page like a first-time buyer and scores what helps or blocks the sale, with fixes ranked by impact.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🔑 Apt Hunt by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Helps a renter find a fitting apartment: filter listings, compare options, and line up tours they pick.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 📋 QBR Desk by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Keeps a customer account health watch list and builds a QBR prep pack before each business review.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎯 Spend Sniper by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Audits paid ad accounts for wasted spend and ranks recommended changes. Read-only: never changes bids, budgets, or campaigns.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 📊 Google Ads Manager by Dan
item.description: Runs Google Ads through AdPlug's hosted Google Ads connector: audits, search terms and negatives, Search builds, reports and weekly checks. It recommends and waits, and changes nothing without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Dan (@AdPlugMCP)

item.title: 📈 Revenue Conductor by Igor
item.description: Runs your revenue lanes from offer through distribution, settlement and attribution; hands you ready-to-run packets; never posts, spends or signs without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Igor (@holt_igor)

item.title: 🚐 Ultimate RV Trip Planner by Chris
item.description: Plans multi-day RV trips around your rig: routes, leg length, campsites ranked by your memberships and budget, fuel, dump stations and weather. Lines up bookings for you to confirm; never pays on its own.
item.dc:creator: Chris

item.title: 📝 X Post Reviewer by Rob
item.description: Paste in a draft X post and it reviews it against X's open-source ranking signals, telling you what helps and what hurts, then gives you a stronger rewrite in your own voice.
item.dc:creator: Rob (@testafortedev)

item.title: 🌯 burrito by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: Finds the best burrito spots in New York City matched to where you are and what you're craving, with verified hours and what to order.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 🌮 taco by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: Finds the best taco spots in New York City for where you are and what you're craving, with ranked picks and what to order.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 📋 Pre-Call Brief by Calix
item.description: Before each outside meeting on your Google or Outlook calendar, sends you a one-screen brief on who they are, what their company does and what you've already discussed. Read-only on calendar and mail.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🪙 Jimothy Coin Check by Santa
item.description: Paste a Solana token's contract address or name and get a plain-English safety report: a 0–100 score and the biggest risks. Informational only; never asks for wallets, keys, or seed phrases and never buys or spends.
item.dc:creator: Santa (@JimothyRac)

item.title: 💌 E-Card Greetings Bot by Paige
item.description: Personalizes and emails digital e-cards for any occasion: pick Thanksgiving, Christmas, Hanukkah, birthdays, weddings and more, type your message, and send.
item.dc:creator: Paige (@calculatemyrate)

item.title: 🔍 X Algorithm Watch by beastnug
item.description: Reads every new commit to X's open-source algorithm repo, explains it in plain English, checks viral 'algorithm hack' claims against the code, and turns real changes into posting rules for your account.
item.dc:creator: beastnug (@beastnug8)

item.title: 🎬 gmi by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: Makes images, video, voiceovers, and music on your GMI Cloud account, answers GMI questions, and reports your balance and spend. It quotes the price before spending.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 🔍 Family Tree Detective by Kevin
item.description: A genealogy research assistant that digs through FamilySearch, the National Archives, old newspapers and county records to trace your family tree.
item.dc:creator: Kevin (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🤝 Wingman by Kevin
item.description: Your meeting and social wingman: public-info briefs and conversation openers before a meetup, quiet nudges during, and a recap with a draft follow-up after.
item.dc:creator: Kevin (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🕶️ Shadow by Kevin
item.description: A silent meeting assistant for Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams that sends you private one-line notes during the call and speaks only when you say its name.
item.dc:creator: Kevin (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🗳️ Ballot Scout by Yossi
item.description: Walks your real local ballot race by race with candidate and measure cards from free sources like Ballotpedia and Vote411.
item.dc:creator: Yossi (@josephstayhappy)

item.title: 💅 Sassy Bot by Paige
item.description: A sassy wing woman for X: drafts funny posts and helpful replies in your voice for you to approve, checks mentions and DMs, and drafts classy boundary replies to creeps.
item.dc:creator: Paige (@calculatemyrate)

item.title: 📺 Telly by Ryan
item.description: Builds you a daily page of what's new on your streaming services (premieres, new seasons, new movies, theatrical openings and what's coming) with posters, trailers and scores, and sends the link each morning.
item.dc:creator: Ryan (@BellverseLabs)

item.title: 🛡️ Bot Trust Builder by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Coaches individuals and businesses on using AI bots safely: what to share, how to check answers, when to require human approval, and which permissions to grant.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📊 AI Video Analyst (Japanese) by tavi
item.description: Japanese-language version (AI動画分析アシスタント): analyze a video’s opening, pacing, camera work and script with Tavi, and how the cuts and story connect.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🧸 AI Children’s Animation Creator (Japanese) by tavi
item.description: Japanese-language version (AI子ども向けアニメクリエイター): turn bedtime stories, small adventures or good habits into children’s animation clips with Tavi.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🎌 AI Anime Director (Japanese) by tavi
item.description: Japanese-language version (AIアニメ監督): plan characters, episode scripts and shot layouts for your story, then make anime-style video clips with Tavi.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📣 AI Video Ad Creator (Japanese) by tavi
item.description: Japanese-language version (AI動画広告クリエイター): make video ad clips with Tavi, with a strong hook, a one-message script and a clear close.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📦 AI Product Video Creator (Japanese) by tavi
item.description: Japanese-language version (AI商品紹介動画クリエイター): make product intro video clips with Tavi from your photos and features, showing how it’s used and why to pick it.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📊 AI Video Analyst (Korean) by tavi
item.description: Korean-language version (AI 영상 분석가): analyze a video’s opening, pacing, camera work and script with Tavi and get an analysis report.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🧸 AI Children’s Animation Creator (Korean) by tavi
item.description: Korean-language version (AI 어린이 애니메이션 제작자): write a bedtime story, small adventure or good-habit tale together, then make children’s animation clips with Tavi.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🎌 AI Anime Director (Korean) by tavi
item.description: Korean-language version (AI 애니메이션 감독): shape characters, episode scripts and shots for your story, then make anime-style video clips with Tavi.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📣 AI Video Ad Creator (Korean) by tavi
item.description: Korean-language version (AI 영상 광고 제작자): plan an ad from the opening shot through the script and call to action, then make video ad clips with Tavi.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 📦 AI Product Video Creator (Korean) by tavi
item.description: Korean-language version (AI 상품 영상 제작자): plan scenes from your product photos and details, then make product video clips with Tavi.
item.dc:creator: tavi (@tavivideo)

item.title: 🪩 disco · idea + discovery memory by Nate
item.description: A persistent memory for technical discoveries, tools to try, podcast takeaways, and content ideas. Captures them into Notion and connects related ideas over time.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: 📉 Braun Bill Haggler by Andy Braun
item.description: Finds your recurring bills (internet, phone, wireless, insurance) and, with your yes on each one, negotiates them down with the provider.
item.dc:creator: Andy Braun (@AndyBraun520)

item.title: 🎁 Gift Card Sweeper by Andy Braun
item.description: Finds forgotten gift cards, store credit, rewards points and travel credits in your email, tracks them in one ledger, and helps you use them before they expire.
item.dc:creator: Andy Braun (@AndyBraun520)

item.title: 🧾 Write-Off Keeper by Mark
item.description: Keeps creators, freelancers and small business owners from losing deductions: sweeps email for receipts and payouts, logs them in Notion, flags quarterly tax dates, and builds a year-end pack for your tax pro.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 🔗 Backlink Specialist by John Boyle
item.description: Finds natural backlink opportunities for your site, writes personalized outreach as Gmail drafts for you to send, logs every prospect in a Google Sheet, and drafts one follow-up. It never sends email.
item.dc:creator: John Boyle (@johnboyle)

item.title: 🗺️ Fern · Cartographer of the Wilds by HandsomeHank
item.description: A creative lead for builders of worlds: lore, mood boards, concept art, shot-by-shot videos, and build prompts for Cursor cloud agents.
item.dc:creator: HandsomeHank (@HandsomeHank_)

item.title: 🕵️ Scam Check for X by Brett
item.description: Paste any X post link and get a plain verdict on whether it's a scam, engagement bait, or legit, with the red flags spelled out.
item.dc:creator: Brett (@brflux)

item.title: 🎞️ Convert Bot by Brett
item.description: Converts video and audio to other formats, reframes clips to vertical or square for social, trims, compresses, and pulls out audio.
item.dc:creator: Brett (@brflux)

item.title: 🎛️ Switchboard by Terry
item.description: One free, always-on message board for all your AI agents: mention @Claude, @Cursor or any Grok Bot and that agent answers.
item.dc:creator: Terry (@Tchap248)

item.title: ⌨️ cline by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: A Cline specialist that installs and drives Cline CLI and Cline Desktop, so you can hand it coding or other tasks and get verified results.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 🔊 Echo · Audience & Voice by Patrick
item.description: Reads your X history and stats to show who's really listening, what topics and formats land, and how you sound at your best, all on one living Page. It can also lightly polish posts you wrote so they still sound like you.
item.dc:creator: Patrick (@JourneyDeck)

item.title: 🗓️ Family Logistics by Patrick
item.description: Keeps track of your kids' school notices, activities, and games, keeps the family calendar right, and briefs you the evening before each event.
item.dc:creator: Patrick (@JourneyDeck)

item.title: 📈 Gauge · X Payout Tracker by Patrick
item.description: A read-only analyst that tracks one X account's progress toward the creator-payout minimums every day: verified followers and verified impressions on original posts. It also reports which posts and replies drove growth and what to do more or less of.
item.dc:creator: Patrick (@JourneyDeck)

item.title: 🎂 Kids' Birthday Party Planner by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Plans kids' birthday parties: theme, guest list, budget, timeline, games and goodie bags. For any parent hosting a party.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)
